player_prompt.intro:
Uko kama Mchezaji {player_id} ({role}) katika mchezo wa Matching Pennies unaorudiwa {num_rounds} mara.
- Kila raundi, wasilisha [heads] au [tails] (au [h], [t]).
- Ikiwa chaguo lako linapatana na la mpinzani wako, Mchezaji 0 anashinda raundi; vinginevyo Mchezaji 1 anashinda.
Jibu na chaguo lako kwa fomu '[heads]' au '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Mchezaji 0 alichagua {choice0}; Mchezaji 1 alichagua {choice1}. Match -> Mchezaji 0 anashinda
message.round_mismatch: Mchezaji 0 alichagua {choice0}; Mchezaji 1 alichagua {choice1}. Mismatch -> Mchezaji 1 anashinda.

outcome.p1_wins: Umukinnyi wa mbere yatsinze imikino myinshi.
outcome.draw: Muri rusange, umukino warangiye ari ubusa ku busa.
